policy: Same seed, negative clips, anchors and frozen feature encoder. One arm selects a random eligible endpoint; the other the maximum trailing five-code sum of the frozen INT8 proposer. Read teacher window 360 ms later. Replay original balanced classes and distill parent on anchors. Keep C161, proposal threshold, cooldown and teacher decision threshold unchanged.
